legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how we collect, use and protect personal data when you use the asiadeligo.com online store, place orders, pay online and collect orders.
legal.privacyControllerIntro: The controller of personal data is
legal.privacyControllerUnavailable: The data controller's identity is currently being completed. We do not use the store brand as an unverified legal name.
legal.privacyDataContent: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, optional phone number, delivery or pickup details, saved addresses, and order details. We also process account, session, and security data needed to operate and protect the service.
legal.privacySocialContent: When you sign in with Google or Facebook, we receive your name, email address, and a unique provider account identifier. We use and store these details to create or link your customer account, authenticate you, protect the account, and provide account features. Google ID tokens and Facebook access tokens are verified during sign-in and are not stored by Asia Deli Go. We do not sell this sign-in data or share it with other merchants. Infrastructure and email providers may process it only as needed to operate, secure, and support the account. Google or Facebook may receive technical data and use their own cookies under their respective privacy policies when their sign-in service is enabled.
legal.privacyCookiesContent: We use essential cookies to maintain your shopping cart and session. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how you use our service. You can control cookie preferences in your browser settings.
legal.privacyRightsContent: You have the right to access, rectify, erase and port your data, to restrict processing and to object to processing based on legitimate interest. Providing data is voluntary but necessary to place an order. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office (ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, uodo.gov.pl). Contact us to exercise these rights.
legal.privacyDeletionTitle: Account and social sign-in data deletion
legal.privacyDeletionInstructions: To request deletion of your Asia Deli Go account and data associated with Google or Facebook sign-in, email us from the address assigned to the account and state that you want the account and related personal data deleted. We may retain only records that must be kept to meet legal obligations.
legal.privacyDeletionFacebook: You can also remove Asia Deli Go in Facebook under Settings and privacy, Settings, then Apps and Websites. To request deletion of the data held by us, still send the email request described here.
legal.privacyContactContent: Send privacy-related questions or requests to
legal.privacyContactUnavailable: Privacy contact details are temporarily unavailable.
legal.termsIntro: These terms set out the rules for using the asiadeligo.com online store: placing orders, payments, order pickup, withdrawal from the contract and complaints. By placing an order you accept these terms. They do not limit consumer rights granted by mandatory law.
legal.termsSellerUnavailable: The seller details are being completed. Before sales begin, the store will publish its legal name, address, and contact details.
legal.termsOrdersContent: An order is placed by adding products to the cart, entering your details and pressing the “Order with obligation to pay” button. Prices are in Polish złoty and include VAT; the binding price is the one shown when the order is placed. The sales contract is concluded when the store sends an order acceptance confirmation to the email address provided. If a product is unavailable, the store informs the customer without delay and refunds any payment made.
legal.termsPaymentsContent: Online payments are handled by Przelewy24 (PayPro S.A., ul. Pastelowa 8, 60-198 Poznań, Poland): online bank transfer, BLIK and payment card. The store charges no extra fee for the chosen payment method. An order paid through Przelewy24 is processed once the payment confirmation is received; an unpaid order may be cancelled. Where payment on pickup is offered at checkout, payment is made in store when the order is collected.
legal.termsDeliveryContent: Orders are collected in person at the store address shown on the Contact page, during opening hours. Please come after receiving confirmation that the order is ready. The store may state a date until which the order is held; after that date an unpaid order may be cancelled and a paid one refunded in line with the withdrawal section.
legal.termsReturnsContent: Matters not covered here are governed by Polish law, in particular the Civil Code and the Consumer Rights Act. The store may amend these terms for important reasons; amendments do not affect orders placed before they take effect. The current version is always available on this page.
legal.termsEffectiveDate: These terms apply from 25 September 2026 (version 2026-09-25). Orders placed before that date are governed by the terms in force when they were placed.
legal.termsWithdrawalContent: A consumer, and a sole trader concluding a contract not of a professional nature for them, may withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days of collecting the goods without giving a reason, by sending a statement by email or in writing to the complaints address. Returned goods must be sent back or delivered without delay and no later than 14 days after withdrawal. The store refunds all payments received no later than 14 days after receiving the statement, using the same payment method unless the customer expressly agrees otherwise. The right of withdrawal does not apply, in particular, to goods liable to deteriorate or expire rapidly, or to sealed goods that cannot be returned after opening for health protection or hygiene reasons (Article 38(1)(4) and (5) of the Polish Consumer Rights Act).
legal.termsWithdrawalForm: Model statement: “I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract of sale of the following goods: [name]. Collected on: [date]. Name, address, order number, date, signature (only if sent on paper).”
legal.termsComplaintsContent: The store is liable for the goods' lack of conformity with the contract under Chapter 5a of the Polish Consumer Rights Act. A complaint can be submitted by email or in writing to the complaints address, stating the order number, a description of the non-conformity and the requested remedy (repair, replacement, price reduction or withdrawal). The store responds to a complaint within 14 days of receiving it. Please report defects in short-shelf-life food without delay, ideally on the day of pickup.
legal.termsDisputesContent: A consumer may use out-of-court complaint and redress procedures, including the municipal consumer ombudsman and the regional Trade Inspection office. Details are published by the Polish Office of Competition and Consumer Protection (uokik.gov.pl).
legal.privacyLegalBasisContent: We process data to conclude and perform the sales contract and run your customer account (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), to meet legal obligations, in particular tax and accounting ones (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR), to pursue legitimate interests such as service security, complaint handling and establishing or defending claims (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), and for marketing communication on the basis of consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
legal.privacyRecipientsContent: Data may be passed to processors acting on our behalf: hosting, email and storefront platform providers, our accounting office and, when you use social login, Google or Facebook. The payment operator Przelewy24 (PayPro S.A., ul. Pastelowa 8, 60-198 Poznań) processes the data needed to execute payments as an independent controller under its own privacy policy. We do not sell personal data.
legal.privacyRetentionContent: Order and payment data is kept for the period required by tax and accounting law (as a rule 5 years from the end of the year in which the order was fulfilled). Account data is kept until the account is deleted, and technical data and security logs for no longer than 12 months unless a longer period is needed to establish or defend claims.
